channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Rustbound Magic Drop Boost
item.description: Raises sentry and riftbloom drops and adds rust crystal recipes for rusty dust and shifting fibers.

item.title: fSkills
item.description: A skill and XP mod to support fClasses for Fragments RP.

item.title: LocalRUAddon
item.description: Русские переводы модов Vintage Story для игры с друзьями

item.title: NoForwardDodge
item.description: Disables the forward dodge of Dodge Master, leaving only the side and back dodges

item.title: Insulated Japanese Architecture
item.description: The same Japanese Archictecture but with insolation and more wood types.

item.title: Stamina
item.description: Adds a stamina bar, making sprinting, swimming, jumping and Combat Overhaul actions cost stamina

item.title: Crown & Coalition Chapter 2
item.description: Chapter 2 additions for C&C.

item.title: Navarlio Customs
item.description: Custom crafts for the Navarlio server.

item.title: Petroleum Age: Iron & Refining Patch
item.description: Petroleum Age: Iron & Refining Patch adds iron-friendly recipes, crude oil → bitumen → coke cooking,

item.title: Sickle
item.description: The right tool for the job.

item.title: NDL TreeHollows
item.description: Add lootable tree hollows that generate throughout your world!

item.title: Debarked
item.description: Intended to be used with Immersive Woodworking. Adds recipes that allows using debarked logs.

item.title: VSA - uireworked
item.description: A UI library that other VSA mods build on. It adds nothing to the game by itself.

item.title: Admin Storage
item.description: A simple mod that adds a /adminstorage command for a server-synced storage to be used by admins.

item.title: After Dusk
item.description: Adds randomized hauntings during the night.

item.title: Head Count
item.description: See whos online your server with a player list, shows their faces too.

item.title: Auto Map Markers (Client-Side Only)
item.description: Fork of Auto Map Markers — works with no server-side install required.

item.title: Diwan's Tools
item.description: A mod that adds a delivery register, wax and clay seals for vessels and trunks.

item.title: Mobs Radar Redux
item.description: Fork of Mobs Radar with 30+ new creature icons and color-coded markers for every 1.22 mob and breed.

item.title: Evenfall Server Patches
item.description: Compatibility and customization pack for the Evenfall server

item.title: VSProfiler
item.description: A mod that's been created to profile and see all the servers cost, along with player fps.

item.title: Recipebook - Trait-locked recipes tab
item.description: Adds a Recipes tab to the survival handbook, listing every trait-locked recipe grouped by trait.

item.title: Player Model NPCs
item.description: Placeable NPCs that can use any PlayerModelLib model, plus in-game activity and dialogue editor

item.title: WOO Fantasy Additions
item.description: A mod focused on bringing the lore of the Oldwood into Vintage Story.

item.title: Balanced High Fertility Soil Recipe
item.description: Adds a balanced recipe to high fertility soil.

item.title: OmniPan - Fork
item.description: This mod adds a chance for the pan to drop any item in the game

item.title: High View
item.description: Fly high and see were you are!

item.title: Evil Ruins
item.description: Adds more menacing and industrial looking ruins.

item.title: Dead
item.description: Leaves a lootable corpse of the player (with their exact skin and worn gear) at the death spot

item.title: fragTweaks
item.description: various mod tweaks and overwrites utilized on Fragments RP
